interface.longDescription: AngelKernel Neural provides a complete autonomous neural cognition OS for AI coding agents. Features include: intent classification across 9 categories with confidence scoring, adaptive routing to optimal agents and skills, a 7-phase unified execution pipeline (NEURAL → ENHANCE → ANALYZE → PLAN → EXECUTE → EVOLVE → REFLECT), automatic skill extraction from repeated patterns, L1-L4 memory cortex with TTL-based working memory, swarm intelligence for consensus and parallel execution, a 73-event universal hook ecosystem, error-correction loop (detect → diagnose → fix → learn), and a pulse daemon for health monitoring and auto-cleanup. All providers are FREE — zero API keys required.
